key.name: snap-on-drag
key.summary: Snap windows by dragging them to a screen edge or corner

key.name: snap-before-edge
key.summary: Snap without dragging all the way to the screen edge
key.description: Start snapping a little before the pointer reaches the edge. Also makes snapping work on an edge shared with another monitor.

key.name: snap-layouts-on-drag
key.summary: Show snap layouts when a window is dragged to the top of the screen

key.name: snap-assist
key.summary: When a window is snapped, suggest what to snap next to it

key.name: snap-fill
key.summary: Size a snapped window to fill the available space

key.name: keyboard-snapping
key.description: Super+Left/Right snap to halves and move between monitors, Super+Up/Down make quarters, maximize, restore and minimize, exactly like Windows.

key.name: show-snap-layouts
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the snap layouts for the focused window

key.name: snap-top-half
key.summary: Shortcut that snaps the focused window to the top half

key.name: snap-bottom-half
key.summary: Shortcut that snaps the focused window to the bottom half

key.name: window-gap
key.summary: Space between snapped windows, in pixels

key.name: saved-edge-tiling
key.summary: GNOME's edge tiling setting from before the extension was enabled ('' when nothing is saved)

key.name: saved-shell-keybindings
key.summary: GNOME Shell keybindings set aside while the extension runs (JSON, restored when it's disabled)
